na_reasons.no_mandi_reported: No mandi in this district reported this crop on the latest price day we hold.
na_reasons.not_assessed_here: This service holds no assessment for this crop in this district.
na_reasons.outside_service_scope: This service does not advise on this crop.
na_reasons.no_forecast_held: No weather forecast is held for this district.
na_reasons.nearby_mandis_only: No mandi in this district reported it. The answer compares the mandis within 150 km, or says that none of them reported it.
na_reasons.statewide_only: Answered for the crop across the state (a representative mandi's price), not for this district's own mandis.

bases.grown_in_district: Official statistics record this crop as grown in this district.
bases.grown_in_state_sold_here: Official statistics record this crop as grown in this state, and this district's own mandis sell it.
bases.sold_here_no_district_record: Official statistics record this crop as grown in this state and this district's mandis sell it, but we hold no record of ANY crop being grown in this district, so its mandis selling a crop does not show the crop is grown here.
bases.sold_here_no_growing_record: This district's mandis sell it, but we hold no official record of it being grown in this district or this state: it may be brought from elsewhere.
bases.sold_here_every_year_no_table: No growing table we hold covers this crop at all, and this district's own mandis sold it in every one of the last 3 crop years: that trade is the only record we hold of it here.
bases.processed_form: The market sells this crop's processed form (milled rice, split pulses), not what a farmer brings to the mandi; the farm produce (paddy, the whole pulse) is offered under its own name.
bases.assessed_only: Only our water, crop or weather assessments hold it for this district; we hold no record of it being grown or sold here.
